title: Understanding the Residual
text: The residual is the difference between the actual observed value and the predicted value from the model. In this case, it's the difference between the actual mission duration and the predicted duration.

title: Calculate the Predicted Duration
text: Use the weight vector \([-3,0.25,2]**T\) and the feature vector for the mission \([1,20,3]**T\) to calculate the predicted duration. The formula is: \(\hat{Y}=X'\hat{\theta}\).

title: Compute the Dot Product
text: Calculate the dot product of the weight vector \([-3,0.25,2]**T\) and the feature vector \([1,20,3]**T\).

title: Find the Predicted Duration
text: Evaluate the expression \(-3+0.25*20+2*3\) to find the predicted duration in sols.

title: Calculate the Residual
text: Subtract the predicted duration from the actual duration to find the residual: $$\(5-4\)$$.
